intro.outfitting: The clerk sells two things: engines, and everything else. Most parties spend the whole budget on the engine and walk out carrying it. The clerk has stopped commenting.
intro.harness_swap: Parties stop here to look at their harness. It is usually the thing they thought was the model. Your engine stays. The car is negotiable.

roleFlavor.vp: The vendor quoted after seeing the org chart. Prices reflect confidence in your budget.
roleFlavor.staff: Standard rates. The requisition form is already filled in. You know where they keep them.
roleFlavor.contractor: Procurement requires a cost center and an employee ID. You have neither. You do have read-only production access, which is somehow more than the staff have, and nobody inventories the free shelf. Scavenge.

lockedReason: Procurement denied. No cost center on file.

notices.scavenge: Scavenged {name}. The budget does not know.
